description: -55℃~+155℃ 50V 62.5mW 82kΩ Thick Film Resistor ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 0402 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS
compatibility_notes: The generic electronic_resistor_0402_82000_ohm already prefers FOJAN C2909388 / FRC0402F8202TS at ±1% (62.5 mW). C1160 is the same 0402 82 kΩ value but ±5%, so do not replace the tighter-tolerance generic preference; represent it as electronic_resistor_0402_82000_ohm_5_percent linked to that generic. JLC and same-code LCSC confirm 50 V, 62.5 mW and ±100 ppm/°C for C1160.
evidence_notes: Live JLC page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/1512-RC02K823JT/C1160 verifies C1160, FH (Guangdong Fenghua Advanced Tech), MPN RC-02K823JT, 0402, 82 kΩ, ±5%, 62.5 mW, 50 V, ±100 ppm/°C, -55 to +155 °C, Extended, SMT Assembly Economic and Standard; stock 705, minimum 1, full reel 10,000, available order qty 679. Same-code LCSC page https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C1160.html confirms exact maker/MPN/code/package and ratings; LCSC retail minimum is 100 pieces in multiples of 100. LCSC visible datasheet link returned an HTML error page; the JLC-visible link was downloaded to C:\Users\aaron\Downloads\C1160 (1).pdf and verified as a 10-page PDF. SHA-256 matches the FH General Thick Film Chip Fixed Resistor datasheet previously visually reviewed at pages 1, 2 and 10 for C1152; page 1 encodes size/value/tolerance and page 2 gives 0402 dimensions and 1/16 W normal rating. The existing generic 82 kΩ part remains the FOJAN ±1% preference; this C1160 is a separate 5% variant.
